$comment: Node app contract example. Copy to azure-deploy.json at your repo root and edit. version is always "1". runtime_version/startup_command/health_check_path/app_settings are optional. Secrets NEVER go in app_settings — use kv_secrets (a human creates the secret in the app's Key Vault first). This example intentionally declares NO kv_secrets: if your app uses a database (drizzle/prisma/knex/...), preflight will REFUSE to deploy until you ask the operator to create the connection-string secret and you declare it in kv_secrets.
